id: 30_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the welding wire
title: 激光焊接机更换焊丝
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/30_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the welding wire.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/30_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Replace the welding wire/src.py

points.K11: 装新焊丝盘、套筒和盖子

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一卷焊丝，站在打开的送丝机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wire spool and stands beside an open blank wire feeder box.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：怎样换成另一种直径的焊丝。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一卷较粗的新焊丝走到送丝机旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks to the wire feeder holding a new, thicker wire spool.
shots.narration: 阿杰要换一卷更粗的焊丝。

shots.scene: 送丝机里装着一卷细焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Inside the open wire feeder sits a spool of thinner wire. No people.
shots.narration: 可送丝机里还装着细的那卷。

shots.scene: 老李走过来，打开送丝机门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over and opens the wire feeder door.
shots.narration: 老李说：换丝径，轮和嘴都要换。

shots.scene: 一细一粗两卷焊丝，中间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two wire spools, one thinner and one thicker, with an arrow from the first to the second. No people.
shots.narration: 以1毫米换1.2毫米焊丝为例。

shots.scene: 老李打开送丝机门，拧下盖子取下套筒
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the wire feeder door, unscrews the cap and slides off the sleeve.
shots.narration: 打开送丝机门，拧下盖子，取下套筒。

shots.scene: 老李扳开两个红色压紧器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips open the two red tensioners on the drive unit.
shots.narration: 打开两个压紧器。

shots.scene: 老李顺时针转动焊丝盘，焊丝从送丝驱动里退出来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns the spool clockwise and the wire slides back out of the drive unit.
shots.narration: 顺时针转焊丝盘，把丝从驱动里退出来。

shots.scene: 老李把焊丝盘从转轴上取下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the old spool off the spindle.
shots.narration: 取下旧焊丝盘。

shots.scene: 焊丝端头弯折，插进盘边的小孔
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the wire end is bent and tucked into a small hole on the rim of the spool. No people.
shots.narration: 丝头弯一下，插进盘边小孔，不会散开。

shots.scene: 老李拧下螺丝，取下送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws and takes the drive rollers off the drive unit.
shots.narration: 拆下螺丝，取下现在的送丝轮。

shots.scene: 老李从上方存放位取出另一对送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the storage pegs above and takes out the spare pair of rollers.
shots.narration: 从上方存放位取出另一对送丝轮。

shots.scene: 送丝轮外侧刻印被放大，旁边是新焊丝盘
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of the blank size mark on the outer side of a drive roller, next to the new wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 核对：送丝轮外侧的尺寸和新焊丝一致。

shots.scene: 老李装上新送丝轮，拧回螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fits the matching rollers and refastens the screws.
shots.narration: 装上新的一对，拧回螺丝。

shots.scene: 换下的送丝轮放回上方存放位
shots.prompt_en: The removed pair of rollers is stored on the pegs above the drive unit. No people.
shots.narration: 换下的那对，存到上方。

shots.scene: 老李拧下送丝管末端的导嘴，换上另一规格
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the nozzle at the end of the feeding tube and fits a nozzle of the other size.

shots.section_title: 装新焊丝盘、套筒和盖子
shots.scene: 老李把新焊丝盘套上转轴，装回套筒和盖子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the new spool onto the spindle, then refits the sleeve and screws on the cap.
shots.narration: 装新焊丝盘，装回套筒，拧好盖子。
overlay: 装新焊丝盘、套筒和盖子

shots.scene: 老李捏住丝头，用钳子剪掉弯头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pinches the wire end and snips off the bent tip with pliers.
shots.narration: 捏住丝头引出来，剪掉弯曲的一段。

shots.scene: 老李把焊丝穿进送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer threads the wire into the drive unit.
shots.narration: 焊丝穿进送丝驱动，

shots.scene: 手指轻压焊丝，穿过送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: A finger lightly presses the wire so it passes between the rollers into the tube. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻压一下，让它穿过送丝轮。

shots.scene: 老李合上压紧器，转动旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the tensioners and turns their knobs.
shots.narration: 合上压紧器，转旋钮调压力。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: A blank adjustment table made of empty rows and columns with dots. No people.
shots.narration: 压力按表格来调。

shots.scene: 老李按住送丝键，焊丝从导嘴伸出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the feed button and the new wire comes out of the brass nozzle.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，送到丝从导嘴伸出。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the wire feeder with icons behind: a spool out, rollers, a nozzle, a spool in.
shots.narration: 退旧丝，换轮换嘴，装新丝，送到位。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 丝头插盘孔，轮的尺寸对丝径。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在送丝机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye beside the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 焊丝换好了，下次见！
